1.why: Headings and body text use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line spacing, though the monospace Logs panel wraps words awkwardly (e.g., 'enrolmen t.').

2.why: Every instruction is a short sentence-case line (e.g., 'Generate backup codes and store them safely.') with no italics, all-caps styling, or dense paragraphs.

3.why: The interface is a single narrow centred column with large text that would fit a phone viewport, although only desktop-width screenshots were provided.

4.why: Each step gives a one-line plain-language instruction, with only occasional technical jargon such as 'Base32' and 'authenticator.'

5.why: The expected six-digit input is demonstrated by the displayed 'Test-only current code: 627186,' although the code field itself shows no placeholder example.

6.why: Step 05 explicitly requires the user to locate the test code inside the dense, multi-line monospace Logs block, so proceeding demands reading a dense block of text.

7.why: The Base32 secret and recovery codes are rendered as plain selectable text that can be copied, but no dedicated copy button is provided.

8.why: Only a manual Base32 secret is offered; no QR code, otpauth link, or equivalent alternative appears in any screenshot.

9.why: Inputs are plain text fields (email, mobile, code) with no visible autocomplete, one-time-code, or password-manager support anywhere in the flow.

10.why: Each screen has a bold heading naming the current step and one prominent blue primary button, though there is no numbered progress indicator.

11.why: Every step requests a single primary action via the blue button, with secondary options like 'Log out' and 'Regenerate codes' visually demoted.

12.why: Headings and short status lines ('MFA is active,' 'Save these codes now.') tell the user what happened and what to do next, though fuller explanations sit in technical log entries.

13.why: 'Regenerate codes' and 'View recovery codes' let the user re-request and re-view codes with no shown penalty, though no hide/reveal toggle or error-retry path is demonstrated.

14.why: All screenshots show only the happy path, so no error message is ever visible and its quality cannot be confirmed.

15.why: No countdown, session timeout, or code-expiry warning appears on any screen, so the UI imposes no visible time pressure.
